name: Streaming Defi D5C1152985
text: Трансформация финансового посредничества под влиянием DeFi presents the following source proposition: Цель исследования — определить, каким образом в условиях децентрализованных финансов (DeFi) воспроизводятся функции, ранее обеспечивающиеся институциональными посредниками. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that When the bid ask spread grows too wide while trades occur at high volume, the market begins to lose liquidity and the asset's value starts to fall, forcing investors who unload positions to surrender unrealized gains. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
